snippet.title: Zoku Gussun Oyoyo (Saturn): First 15 minutes
snippet.description: Zoku Gussun Oyoyo is a simple puzzle platformer wherein you use blocks and bombs to guide a small treasure hunting baby (...sure) across the screen to the goal. It's surprisingly addictive and at a 79/100 score from contemporary critics (according to SegaRetro), it was quite well received.
